caption: The drawing depicts a room with wooden cabinetry and storage furniture against cream-colored walls and a wooden plank floor. On the left, there is a partially visible wooden door with a metal handle. Adjacent to it is a built-in cabinet with double doors and a light-colored countertop. Above this countertop are two wall-mounted shelves supported by black metal brackets, along with a vertical slat wall panel beneath the shelves. Next to the cabinet is a tall, narrow wooden cupboard with double doors and a single visible brass knob. To the right side of the composition, against the far wall, there is a wide, low credenza with four doors and a flat surface on top. A wooden rail or molding runs horizontally along the far wall, slightly above the height of the credenza. The cabinetry and furniture are illustrated in shades of medium brown with line detailing suggesting wood grain, and the hardware on the cabinetry is rendered in brass or dark metal tones.
title: Built-In Furniture
